steps.code:
# The current date is 2023-05-18. So "this month so far" means from 2023-05-01 to 2023-05-18. Let me fetch all transactions in this period, paginating through all pages.
access_token = login_response["access_token"]
all_transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=access_token, min_created_at="2023-05-01", max_created_at="2023-05-18", page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    print(f"Page {page_index}: {len(page)} transactions")
    if len(page) == 0:
        break
    all_transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total transactions: {len(all_transactions)}")

# The amount is always positive. I need to determine sent vs received by checking if Jordan is the sender or receiver. Let me calculate the total money sent and received.
my_email = "jo-harr@gmail.com"
total_sent = 0.0
total_received = 0.0
for txn in all_transactions:
    if txn["sender"]["email"] == my_email:
        total_sent += txn["amount"]
    elif txn["receiver"]["email"] == my_email:
        total_received += txn["amount"]

print(f"Total received: {total_received}")
